mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Gaspé Copper Project near Murdochville, Quebec (acquired July 2023 from Glencore Canada; former producing Noranda open pit; potential restart early 2030s). April 2026 updated MRE (post-118,000 m 2025 drill campaign): pit-constrained M&I 1.83 Bt @ 0.27% Cu (0.32% CuEq) = 10.8B lb (4.88 Mt) Cu + 673M lb Mo + 93Moz Ag; inferred 239 Mt @ 0.41% Cu (0.46% CuEq) = 2.2B lb (0.98 Mt) Cu + 83M lb Mo + 14Moz Ag. Prior Nov 2024 MRE: indicated 824 Mt @ 0.34% CuEq (2.23 Mt Cu, 274M lb Mo, 46Moz Ag); inferred 670 Mt @ 0.38% CuEq (1.99 Mt Cu, 133k t Mo, 29.5Moz Ag). PEA deferred pending 2025 drill results (50,000 m 2026 program underway). No production.
Past-producing zinc-lead project, Northwest Territories. PEA-stage/exploration asset; no production.

notes: Base-metals developer; no FY2025 production or revenue. TSX:OM (graduated from TSX-V), OTCQX:OMZNF. CEO Robert Wares. Silver is a byproduct metal in Gaspé copper resources (~46Moz Ag indicated, ~29.5Moz inferred in Nov 2024 MRE). No mineral reserves declared. All figures in CAD unless noted.
report_title: Osisko Metals Grows Gaspé Copper Project Resource with Major MRE Update (news release, April 2026)
